events.text: Kelvin billed you $3.20 for borrowing his pen.

outcomes.text: Paid Kelvin $3.20. He issued a receipt.
Paid in coins. Kelvin counted twice.
Ignored pen invoice. Reminder came at 5:59pm.
Kelvin added late fees. Pen now costs $40.
Billed Kelvin for oxygen. He paid. Scary.
Counter-invoiced Kelvin. Grudge level: legendary.

events.text: Kelvin replied to you: "Per my last email."

outcomes.text: Replied 'per my previous email.' War declared.
Replied 'noted with thanks.' Kelvin felt nothing.
Deleted email. Kelvin printed it, left on desk.
Deleted email. Nobody noticed. Peace.

events.text: Kelvin eating alone at hawker. Join him?

outcomes.text: Shared chicken rice with Kelvin. He split bill exactly.
Kelvin smiled once. You both pretended otherwise.
Walked past Kelvin. He saw. He remembers.

events.text: Kelvin is auditing your expense claims from 2023.

outcomes.text: Showed receipts. Kelvin found a $0.40 error.
Receipts perfect. Kelvin looked genuinely disappointed.
Bribed Kelvin with kaya toast. Audit softened.
Kelvin reported the bribe. To himself.
Shredded receipts. Kelvin heard it three floors away.

events.text: Kelvin booked a 'quick sync.' It's three hours.

outcomes.text: Attended Kelvin's sync. Learned stapler policy by heart.
Declined meeting. Kelvin replied 'Declined?' Just that.
Brought keropok to sync. Kelvin billed crumb cleanup.

events.text: Your stapler is missing. Kelvin's desk has two now.

outcomes.text: Confronted Kelvin. He produced stapler ownership certificate.
Stole stapler back. Kelvin installed a CCTV.
Stole wrong stapler. Now own three.

events.text: Dress-down Friday. Kelvin wearing receipt-print shirt.

outcomes.text: Complimented Kelvin's shirt. He blushed slightly more lilac.
Laughed at Kelvin's shirt. Added to The List.

events.text: Kelvin's birthday. Nobody remembered. He's sitting alone.

outcomes.text: Bought Kelvin a cake. He cried onto receipt.
Forgot Kelvin's birthday. He did not forget.

events.text: Secret Santa. You drew Kelvin.

outcomes.text: Gave Kelvin receipt organiser. He wept with joy.
Gave Kelvin socks. He expensed them back to you.

events.text: Sudden downpour. Only Kelvin has an umbrella.

outcomes.text: Borrowed Kelvin's umbrella. Rental fee: $4 per minute.
Ran through rain. Arrived looking like Gloop.

events.text: You and Kelvin up for the same promotion.

outcomes.text: Won promotion fairly. Kelvin baked you a bitter cake.
Lost to Kelvin. He sent a condolence invoice.
Let Kelvin win. Now he's paranoid about why.
Changed Kelvin's slides to Comic Sans. Got promoted.

events.text: Kelvin confides: 'Nobody reimburses my feelings.'

outcomes.text: Hugged Kelvin. He crinkled. Grudge reset.
Billed Kelvin for therapy. He paid gladly.

events.text: Kelvin offers to make you his successor.

outcomes.text: Accepted. Turned lilac. Receipt started growing.
Declined. Kelvin gave you his favourite pen.

events.text: Kelvin asks to 'grab kopi. Non-work related.'

outcomes.text: Had kopi with Kelvin. He paid. Shocking.
Kopi date. Kelvin brought a spreadsheet of topics.
Declined Kelvin. He filed it under 'pending.'
Tried to expense the date. Kelvin rejected it.

events.text: Kelvin sent an invoice for your second date.

outcomes.text: Split the date 50/50. Kelvin called it romance.
Paid in love. Kelvin accepted. Grudge waived.
Kelvin doesn't accept love. Added GST.
Dumped Kelvin by email. He replied-all.

events.text: Kelvin wants you to meet his parents. They're receipts.

outcomes.text: Met Kelvin's parents. Mum itemised your flaws.
Parents approved. His father laminated you.
Took MC to dodge parents. Gloop noticed.

events.text: Kelvin proposed with a ring made of staples.

outcomes.text: Married Kelvin. Wedding cost split to the cent.
Asked for time. Kelvin set a deadline: Friday.
Rejected Kelvin. He audited your life for vengeance.

events.text: BTO delayed again. Your landlord kicked you out.

outcomes.text: Rented Kelvin's spare room. Deposit: $1,800.
Slept under desk. Aircon freezing. Security waved.
Moved home. Mum asked about marriage nightly.

events.text: Kelvin's rent invoice itemises your aircon usage per minute.

outcomes.text: Paid aircon surcharge. Now sleep sweating at 28°C.
Switched to fan. Kelvin billed fan depreciation.
Disputed bill. Kelvin produced a 47-page appendix.
Won the dispute. Kelvin cried in bathroom.

events.text: Saw Kelvin at home in receipt-print pyjamas.

outcomes.text: Photo went viral in office chat. Kelvin knows.
Kept photo as leverage. Rent dropped $100.
Pretended not to see. Kelvin left thank-you note.

events.text: Kelvin wants the pyjama photo deleted. Offers a deal.

outcomes.text: Deleted photo. Kelvin waived three months' rent.
Demanded more. Kelvin countered with your browser history.

events.text: Kelvin raising rent because you 'breathe too loudly.'

outcomes.text: Moved out of Kelvin's. Freedom smells like kopi.
Learned to breathe quietly. Sanity also quiet now.
Bought Kelvin's flat. Now you're his landlord.

events.text: Night security invites you to midnight mahjong.

outcomes.text: Won mahjong. Security now calls you 'boss.'
Lost mahjong. Owe security guard your lunch.
Slept. Cleaner vacuumed carefully around you.

events.text: Kelvin quietly buying company shares with your reimbursements.

outcomes.text: Joined Kelvin's faction. Received a numbered receipt.
Warned Boss Tan. He was busy with a crystal.
Boss Tan thanked you. Kelvin vowed revenge.
Stayed neutral. Kelvin noted it. In pencil.

events.text: Kelvin launched a hostile takeover. Boss Tan's robe confiscated.

outcomes.text: Backed Kelvin. Promoted to Vice President of Receipts.
Kelvin named you successor. You turned lilac.
Defended Boss Tan. Wizard magic saved the company.
Tan lost. Kelvin fired you, effective yesterday.
Out-takeovered Kelvin. Became CEO by accident.
Failed coup. Desk moved beside printer permanently.

events.text: Brought durian to the pantry. Kelvin smelled it.

outcomes.text: Shared durian. Whole floor loved you. Except Kelvin.
Aircon spread durian. Building evacuated. Legendary.
Threw durian away. Mourned quietly.

events.text: Kelvin microwaved salted fish beside your desk. Revenge.

outcomes.text: Microwaved durian. HR declared office a war zone.
Signed durian treaty with Kelvin. Auntie notarised.
Wore N95 all day. Felt like 2020.

events.text: Durian war escalated. Kelvin brought a whole crate.

outcomes.text: Ate the entire crate. Kelvin conceded. Stomach didn't.
Surrendered to Kelvin. He framed your white flag.

events.text: Leftover client gift budget. Sales wants 'something memorable.'

outcomes.text: Expensed a goat. Kelvin noticed.
Bought chocolates. Client forgot you instantly.
Pocketed budget. CFO's one eye twitched.
Pocketed budget. Got caught. HR meeting booked.

events.text: The goat now attends every Sales meeting.

outcomes.text: Gave goat a tie. Goat closed a $50k deal.
Fed goat Kelvin's receipts. Kelvin filed police report.
Tried returning goat. Goat refused. Goat stays.

events.text: The goat got promoted above you.

outcomes.text: Saluted goat manager. Goat approved your leave.
Protested goat promotion. Gloop sided with goat.
Goat replaced you entirely. Sales up 300%.
Became goat's right hand. Career skyrocketed.

events.text: Typing rant about Kelvin. Cursor hovering over 'Reply All.'

outcomes.text: Sent privately. Survived. Heart rate normal-ish.
Accidentally replied-all. 200 people read it.
Deleted draft. Grew as a person.

events.text: Office made a reply-all sticker pack of your face.

outcomes.text: Became reply-all legend. Interns asked for autographs.
Hid in pantry three hours. Auntie fed you.

events.text: Boss Tan wants you to email the whole company.

outcomes.text: Sent perfect email. Redemption arc complete.
Attached all your Grab receipts by accident.
Attached memes. Promoted to Head of Culture.
Fled reply-all shame. New name: Darren.

events.text: Your signature says 'Senior Manger.' Boss Tan read it.

outcomes.text: Fixed typo. Nobody cared. Life continued.
Boss thought you're a Manager. Got promoted.
Kelvin corrected you publicly. With red pen.

events.text: Boss assigned you 12 direct reports. You don't know how.

outcomes.text: Said 'let's circle back' 40 times. Promoted again.
Exposed. Officially demoted to 'Manger.'
Jun Wei did everything. You took credit.

events.text: Friend says sell kueh online. 'Easy money,' she says.

outcomes.text: Opened Shopee kueh shop. Sold three to Mum.
Declined. Watched dramas. Peaceful.

events.text: Gloop caught you packing kueh at your desk.

outcomes.text: Bribed Gloop with ondeh-ondeh. Gloop now wants shares.
Denied. Kelvin produced timestamped photos.
Denied. Gloop absorbed the kueh. Evidence gone.

events.text: Your kueh video hit 2 million views overnight.

outcomes.text: Quit to sell kueh full-time. Became millionaire.
Ran kueh empire from toilet cubicle. Sanity frayed.
Hired Kelvin as kueh CFO. He's thriving.

events.text: Printer jammed. It looks... hungry.

outcomes.text: Smacked printer. It printed 'I REMEMBER.'
Smacked printer. It worked. Respect earned.
Whispered to printer. It purred. Bond formed.
Called IT. Ghost Receipt said 'restart lor.'

events.text: Printer demands an offering. Preferably Kelvin's receipts.

outcomes.text: Fed printer Kelvin's receipts. Kelvin searching everywhere.
Fed printer biscuits. It printed 'thank you.'
Refused printer. Your reports now print in Comic Sans.

events.text: Printer whispers your name. Paper tray opens wide.

outcomes.text: Entered the printer. Became toner. Very warm.
Unplugged printer. Office scanner glared at you.
Printer printed your CV. Recruiter called instantly.

events.text: Ghost Receipt asks you to badge in for him.

outcomes.text: Badged Ghost in. Third time this week.
Asked why. Ghost said 'WFH since 2020, bro.'
Reported Ghost. Gloop asked, 'We have IT?'

events.text: Ghost Receipt invites you to his 'home office.'

outcomes.text: Visited Ghost's home. It's just a laptop in a cloud.
Declined. Ghost replied with a single 'k.'

events.text: Ghost offers to teach you eternal WFH. No return.

outcomes.text: Logged off forever. Now just an Outlook status.
Stayed in office. Aircon still freezing.

events.text: Jun Wei asks to shadow you. Extremely eager.

outcomes.text: Mentored Jun Wei. He took notes on your sighs.
Made intern your kopi runner. Kopi always perfect.
Hid from intern. He found you. Always finds you.

events.text: Jun Wei got promoted. He's now your manager.

outcomes.text: Jun Wei approved your leave. Felt proud. Weird.
Sabotaged Jun Wei. Caught. Desk moved by toilet.
Jun Wei promoted you back out of gratitude.
Cried in pantry. Auntie gave you extra Milo.

events.text: Auntie Rosie offers you her 'secret' teh recipe.

outcomes.text: Learned Auntie's teh. Hands permanently sticky now.
Too busy for teh. Auntie gave you weaker Milo.

events.text: Auntie whispers: 'CFO's eye... not the real one.'

outcomes.text: Learned CFO's secret. Now know too much.
Covered ears. Auntie respected that.

events.text: Auntie retiring. She wants you to inherit the pantry.

outcomes.text: Inherited the pantry. Feared, loved, caffeinated.
Declined pantry. Auntie hugged you. Smelled of Milo.

events.text: CFO blinked at you. Twice. Knowingly.

outcomes.text: Winked back. CFO promoted you for silence.
Winked back. Black van appeared outside.
Ran to Grab. Driver also had one eye.

events.text: Woke up feeling 'a bit sick.' It's Monday.

outcomes.text: Took MC. Watched dramas. Recovered by noon.
Took MC. Boss saw your Sentosa story.
Went to work sick. Infected Kelvin. Revenge.

events.text: Gloop wants to 'have a chat' about your MC.

outcomes.text: Fake coughed. Gloop absorbed it. Case closed.
Overacted cough. Gloop issued warning letter.
Confessed. Gloop cried green tears. Forgave you.

events.text: Bat Invoice 'at client meeting.' His story shows Sentosa.

outcomes.text: Joined Bat's 'client meeting.' Expensed four jugs.
Screenshotted Bat's story. Leverage acquired.
Covered Bat's calls all day. Unpaid.

events.text: Bat offers his biggest client. 'Just delete the screenshot.'

outcomes.text: Deleted screenshot. Inherited Bat's client. Commission!
Sent proof to Kelvin. Bat audited into oblivion.

events.text: Stuck in lift with Boss Tan. Twenty minutes.

outcomes.text: Pitched in lift. Boss made you Head of Ideas.
Silent lift ride. Boss Tan hummed for 20 minutes.
Asked Boss Tan for magic. He fixed the lift.

events.text: Boss Tan casts 'synergy' spell at town hall.

outcomes.text: Clapped loudest. Boss Tan remembered your face.
Slept through synergy. Woke up reorganised.
Asked about bonuses. Boss Tan vanished in smoke.

events.text: Boss Tan pitching investors. Needs a volunteer presenter.

outcomes.text: Nailed pitch. Investors threw money. Boss threw confetti.
Froze mid-pitch. Said 'per my last email.'
Hid in toilet. Jun Wei presented. Got promoted.

events.text: Bonus season! CFO announces 'one month... of thanks.'

outcomes.text: Got a thank-you card. Kelvin laminated it.
Negotiated hard. Got two months' bonus. Huat!
Negotiated. CFO stared. One eye, infinite judgment.
Updated LinkedIn. 40 'exciting opportunities' arrived.

events.text: Appraisal day. Gloop asks: 'Rate yourself, 1 to 5.'

outcomes.text: Rated myself 5. Boss agreed. Promoted on vibes.
Rated 5. Kelvin submitted counter-evidence.
Rated 3. Got 3. Safe and forgettable.
Cried in appraisal. Gloop hugged me. Sticky.

events.text: Restructuring rumours. Gloop smiling way too much.

outcomes.text: Typed loudly eight hours. Survived restructuring.
Updated CV. Then got promoted. Ironic.
Took retrenchment package. Retired to Batam. Rich-ish.
Package was one tin of Milo.

events.text: Boss Tan retiring to become a full-time wizard.

outcomes.text: Boss Tan knighted you CEO with a mop.
Boss Tan laughed. Made Kelvin interim CEO.
Became wizard apprentice. Robe slightly itchy.

events.text: Boss Tan offers you a corner office. No windows.

outcomes.text: Took windowless corner office. Very prestigious darkness.
Asked for window. Got a poster of one.

events.text: CFO staring at your Grab claims. One eye. Unblinking.

outcomes.text: Explained Grab claims. CFO blinked. First time ever.
Hid behind plant. CFO's eye found you.

events.text: CNY! Boss Tan giving out ang baos. Queue forming.

outcomes.text: Got ang bao. $8. Very auspicious.
Boss's ang bao had a gold bar. Huat!
Brought pineapple tarts. Kelvin calculated the calories.

events.text: NDP rehearsal jets roaring. Meeting completely ruined.

outcomes.text: Watched jets from window. Felt patriotic. Skipped meeting.
Continued meeting. Nobody heard anything. Agreed anyway.

events.text: Team bonding at Sentosa. Mandatory fun. On Saturday.

outcomes.text: Won tug-of-war alone. Colleagues fear you now.
Mysterious MC on bonding day. Gloop suspicious.
Sang NDP songs at karaoke. Boss Tan cried.

events.text: Office aircon set to 16°C. Fingers frozen.

outcomes.text: Wore winter jacket indoors. Very Singaporean.
Adjusted aircon. Kelvin adjusted back. Cold war.
Broke thermostat. Office now a sauna.

events.text: Grab driver cancelled. Meeting in ten minutes.

outcomes.text: Sprinted to office. Arrived drenched. Looked dedicated.
Paid $38 surge. Arrived on time. Poorer.
Dialled in from Grab. Driver sang along loudly.

events.text: Someone stole your Yakult from the pantry fridge.

outcomes.text: It was Kelvin. He left a receipt.
It was Boss Tan. You said nothing.
Left passive-aggressive note. Kelvin graded it 7/10.

events.text: D&D lucky draw! Your number is 44.

outcomes.text: Won nothing. Clapped for Kelvin's new iPad.
Won grand prize: a fridge. For durians.
Swapped with intern. He won $1,000. Pain.
Swapped tickets. Won a staycation.

events.text: Chicken rice queue is 30 minutes. Lunch hour ticking.

outcomes.text: Queued 30 minutes. Worth every grain.
Ate vending machine bread. Soul slightly dimmer.
Ordered GrabFood. Delivered to wrong building.

events.text: Excel crashed. Three hours unsaved.

outcomes.text: Screamed into pantry fridge. Auntie nodded.
Ghost Receipt recovered it remotely. Hero.
Ghost replied six days later: 'Fixed?'
Kelvin had a printed backup. Bill: $50.

events.text: Two-hour meeting that could've been an email.

outcomes.text: Endured meeting. Briefly lost will to live.
Said 'could be email.' Room clapped silently.
Said it. Boss scheduled a meeting about it.
Fake-called 'client.' Bat Invoice approved technique.

events.text: You're on kopi run duty. Six orders.

outcomes.text: Nailed all orders. Kopi-O kosong siu dai, perfect.
Got Kelvin's order wrong. Siu dai, not kosong.
Refused kopi run. Branded 'not team player.'

events.text: Ask Gloop for WFH Fridays?

outcomes.text: Got WFH Fridays. Productivity: questionable.
Denied. Gloop cited 'culture.' Culture is aircon.
Skipped Friday. Nobody noticed. Like Ghost.

events.text: Office birthday. Collecting $10 each for cake.

outcomes.text: Paid $10. Got the smallest slice.
Didn't pay. Ate cake anyway. Kelvin noticed.

events.text: Payday! Salary credited.

outcomes.text: Bubble tea all week. Broke by Thursday.
Saved salary. Kelvin nodded approvingly.
Bought meme coin. Down 90% by lunch.
Bought kaya toast stocks. Up 200%.

events.text: Gloop's 'mental wellness week.' Mandatory yoga.

outcomes.text: Did yoga beside Kelvin. He counted my breaths.
Napped on yoga mat. Best wellness ever.

events.text: Your tissue packet chope got stolen at hawker.

outcomes.text: Confronted chope thief. It was the CFO.
Ate laksa standing. Spilled on shirt.

events.text: Jun Wei asks: 'Can I have your desk?'

outcomes.text: Gave intern my desk. Now sitting on printer.
Refused. Jun Wei cried at 140 decibels.

events.text: BTO ballot results out. Queue number: 2,847.

outcomes.text: Hoped. Queue number didn't move. Hope did.
Kelvin calculated odds: 0.3%. Charged consulting fee.

events.text: It's 11pm. Still in office. Boss Tan emails 'urgent.'

outcomes.text: Replied at 11pm. Boss replied 'thx.' Worth it?
Replied. Then lay under desk. Forever.
Turned phone off. Slept. Won life.

events.text: Kelvin filed an HR complaint: your keyboard 'too loud.'

outcomes.text: Typed with fingertips only. Productivity halved.
Typed like a pianist. Kelvin wore earmuffs.
Gloop mediated. Both received sticky slime.

events.text: Saw Ghost Receipt in the office. First time since 2020.

outcomes.text: Took photo. Only a blurry laptop appeared.
Said hi. Ghost said 'unmute yourself.'

quiet.text: Kopi was too sweet.
Aircon was freezing. Wore jacket.
Found $2 in old pants.
Lunch at hawker. Chicken rice, no regrets.
Replied 'noted with thanks' 14 times.
MRT breakdown. Arrived late.
Kelvin nodded at you. Unsettling.
Printer worked first try. Suspicious.
Ate cai png. Uncle gave extra egg.
Zoned out for an hour. Nobody noticed.
Auntie Rosie remembered your order.
Gloop sent a wellness newsletter. Deleted.
Raining. Grab surge. Took bus.
Bat Invoice 'at client meeting' again.
Finished a report. Nobody read it.
Jun Wei said 'good morning' seven times.
Pantry had free kueh. Grabbed four.
Wore same shirt as Kelvin. Awkward.
Spotify played the perfect song. Productive.
Boss Tan walked past humming. Robe swished.
Bubble tea run. Treated yourself.
Updated Excel. Excel did not update.
Kelvin borrowed a tissue. Repaid with interest.
Left at 6pm sharp. Felt rebellious.
Cyclops CFO blinked once. Rare sighting.

fired.title: Fired
fired.text: Escorted out with one box. Kelvin billed you for the box.

burnout.title: Total Burnout
burnout.text: Lay under desk. Became one with the carpet. Took long MC.

ceo.title: CEO
ceo.text: You run the company now. Kelvin still invoices you weekly.

became_kelvin.title: You Became Kelvin
became_kelvin.text: Lilac skin. Long receipt. You now say 'per my last email.'

quit_rich.title: Quit Rich
quit_rich.text: Left with money. Sent farewell email. Reply-all, on purpose.

witness_protection.title: Witness Protection
witness_protection.text: New name, new country. Still get Kelvin's invoices somehow.

absorbed_by_printer.title: Absorbed by Printer
absorbed_by_printer.text: You are toner now. Every printout carries a little of you.

goat_replaced.title: Replaced by Goat
goat_replaced.text: The goat took your job. It's honestly better at it.

eternal_wfh.title: Eternal WFH
eternal_wfh.text: Camera off forever. You exist only as 'Away' status now.

pantry_heir.title: Pantry Heir
pantry_heir.text: You rule the pantry. Even Big Boss Tan fears your teh.

married_kelvin.title: Married Kelvin
married_kelvin.text: Happily married. Every anniversary arrives with an itemised invoice.

kelvin_lines: I eat lunch alone by choice.
I've added this to your file.
Nobody asked me to lunch. Fine.
